title: Liam Coen: I have a lot of confidence in Travis Hunter to go out and compete for us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Liam Coen: I have a lot of confidence in Travis Hunter to go out and compete for us
sources.description: On the night of the first round of last year's draft, the Browns and Jaguars made a trade that allowed Jacksonville to select Travis Hunter at No. 2 overall.
